Unit 1（核心知识）##一、核心词汇.t:
1. 根据句意及首字母提示补全单词：Thomas Edison was a very i______ man and he invented many things.
答案：intelligent

2. 用括号中所给单词的适当形式填空：Lang Lang is a ______ (talent) pianist and many people like his music.
答案：talented

3. 选择最佳答案：The old man can ______ remember what happened on that day, because it was too terrible.
A. maybe  B. perhaps  C. completely  D. hardly
答案：C

4. 句型转换：The book is about the birth of a famous artist.（改为一般疑问句）
答案：Is the book about the birth of a famous artist?

5. 完成句子：我们应该学会独立组织我们的学习活动。
We should learn to ______ our study activities by ourselves.
答案：organize

6. 根据句意，用适当的介词填空：Please write your name ______ the top of the notebook.
答案：at

Unit 1（核心知识）##二、核心短语.t:
将下列中文翻译成英文：灭绝
答案：die out

用恰当的短语填空：This kind of bird is ______ ______（与……相似）the one in the picture.
答案：similar to

单项选择：The two languages ______ each other, so they have some similar words.
A. are related to  B. go back a long way  C. play an important role  D. die out
答案：A

句型转换：These books are in alphabetical order.（对划线部分提问，划线部分为 in alphabetical order）
答案：How are these books?

完成句子：熊猫已经在地球上生活了很久。
Pandas have ______ ______ ______ ______ on the earth.
答案：gone back a long way

根据首字母提示拼写单词：Please put these names in a______ order.
答案：alphabetical

Unit 1（核心知识）##三、重点句型.t:
1. DaVinci was extremely ________ (intelligence) and talented in many different fields.
答案：intelligent
2. His notebooks ________ some interesting drawings of flying machines and other vehicles.
A. include  B. includes  C. including  D. included
答案：A
3. Some dinosaurs were as small as chickens, and ________ were as big as ten elephants.
答案：others
4. About 66 million years ago, dinosaurs suddenly ________ ________.
答案：died out
5. They were similar ________ early Chinese encyclopaedias because they included works by different scholars.
答案：to
6. Yuan spent his whole life ________ (develop) different kinds of hybrid rice.
答案：developing

Unit 1（核心知识）##四、核心语法.t:
1. 用 some 或 any 填空：I'm thirsty. Could you give me ______ water?
答案：some

2. 用 some 或 any 填空：He doesn't have ______ brothers or sisters.
答案：any

3. 单项选择：There isn't ______ in the classroom. Everyone is on the playground.
A. somebody  B. anybody  C. nobody
答案：B

4. 用括号内单词的正确形式填空：Everyone ______ (like) music in our class.
答案：likes

5. 将下列句子改为否定句：I have something important to tell you.
答案：I don't have anything important to tell you.

6. 根据汉语意思完成句子，每空一词：你想喝点什么吗？
Would you like ______ ______ ______?
答案：something to drink

Unit 1（核心知识）##全部.t:
1. 用括号内所给单词的适当形式填空：Da Vinci was unusually ________ (talent) in many different fields.
答案：talented
2. 根据汉语意思完成句子：恐龙大约6600万年前突然灭绝了。Dinosaurs suddenly ________ ________ about 66 million years ago.
答案：died out
3. 单项选择：Yuan Longping spent his ________ life developing different kinds of hybrid rice.
A. whole  B. original  C. prehistoric  D. artistic
答案：A
4. 用 some 或 any 填空：Would you like ________ bananas?
答案：some
5. 单项选择：There isn't ________ in the classroom.
A. anybody  B. somebody  C. nobody  D. everybody
答案：A
6. 将下列句子翻译成英语：每个人都有他自己的爱好。Everyone ________ his own hobby.
答案：has

Unit 1（知识梳理）##第 1 部分.t:
1. 根据音标写出下列单词：/ˈdaɪnəsɔː(r)/ ________；/ˈteləntɪd/ ________；/ˈɔːɡənaɪz/ ________。  
答案：dinosaur；talented；organize

2. 用方框中所给短语的适当形式填空：be talented in, die out, be related to, go back a long way  
(1) This kind of bird ________ the eagle.  
(2) The tradition of eating mooncakes ________ in China.  
(3) Many animals will ________ if we don't protect them.  
(4) Lang Lang ________ playing the piano.  
答案：(1) is related to (2) goes back a long way (3) die out (4) is talented in

3. 单项选择：Yuan Longping spent his whole life ________ hybrid rice.  
A. develop　B. developing　C. to develop　D. developed  
答案：B

4. 按要求完成句子：Da Vinci was talented in many different fields.（改为一般疑问句）  
________ Da Vinci ________ in many different fields?  
答案：Was；talented

5. 根据汉语意思完成句子，每空一词：有些恐龙像鸡一样小，有些像十头大象一样大。  
Some dinosaurs were ________ ________ ________ chickens, and ________ were as big as ten elephants.  
答案：as small as；others

6. 用 some 或 any 填空：  
(1) There are ________ interesting drawings in his notebook.  
(2) Do you have ________ questions about dinosaurs?  
(3) I don't have ________ brothers or sisters.  
答案：(1) some (2) any (3) any

Unit 1（知识梳理）##一、 some 和 any的用法.t:
1. 用 some 或 any 填空：I have ______ questions to ask you.
答案：some

2. 用 some 或 any 填空：Do you have ______ brothers or sisters?
答案：any

3. 选出正确的一项：Would you like ______ tea?
A. any  B. some  C. many  D. a
答案：B

4. 句型转换：I have some money.（改为否定句）
答案：I don't have any money.

5. 完成句子：这所学校的任何一个学生都不应该迟到。（每空一词）
______ student in this school should ______ be late.
答案：Any; not

6. 用 some 或 any 填空：There isn't ______ milk in the fridge. You need to buy ______.
答案：any; some

Unit 1（知识梳理）##二、复合不定代词.t:
1. 用 someone, anyone, nobody, everything 填空：______ is here, so we can begin the meeting.
答案：Everyone

2. 选择填空：There is ______ in the box. It is empty.
A. something  B. anything  C. nothing  D. everything
答案：C

3. 选择填空：I have ______ important to tell you.
A. something  B. anything  C. nothing  D. everything
答案：A

4. 选择填空：______ in our class likes Mr. Wang because he is kind.
A. Someone  B. Anyone  C. Everyone  D. Nobody
答案：C

5. 句型转换：There is something interesting in today's newspaper.（改为一般疑问句）
答案：Is there anything interesting in today's newspaper?

6. 完成句子：每个人都应该保持安静。
______ ______ keep quiet.
答案：Everyone should

Unit 1（知识梳理）##全部.t:
1. 用括号内所给单词的适当形式填空：Da Vinci was extremely ______ (intelligence), and he was unusually ______ (talent) in many different fields.
答案：intelligent；talented
2. 根据汉语意思完成句子：恐龙大约6600万年前突然灭绝了。About 66 million years ago, dinosaurs suddenly ______ ______.
答案：died out
3. 单项选择：Some dinosaurs were ______ small as chickens, and ______ were as big as ten elephants.
A. so; others  B. as; others  C. as; other  D. so; the others
答案：B
4. 用方框中所给短语的适当形式填空：be famous for  /  one of  /  go back a long way  /  in alphabetical order
The editors organized the entries ______.
答案：in alphabetical order
5. 单项选择：—Would you like ______ to drink? —Yes, please. I'd like some orange juice.
A. anything  B. something  C. everything  D. nothing
答案：B
6. 用括号内所给单词的适当形式填空：Either Tom or his friends ______ (be) coming to the party.
答案：are

Unit 2（核心知识）##一、核心词汇.t:
1. 根据中文意思写出正确的英语单词：航程；日程安排。
答案：flight；schedule

2. 用方框中的单词填空：Everywhere / Currently / Exactly
________, more and more people are using mobile phones to check their schedules.
答案：Currently

3. 选择最佳答案：The word "challenge" in the sentence "He challenged me to a game of chess" means ________.
A. 承诺  B. 向（某人）挑战  C. 回复  D. 检查
答案：B

4. 句型转换：I wonder where he is from.（改为同义句，用 do you think 改写）
________ do you think he is from?
答案：Where

5. 用所给词的适当形式填空：He agreed ________ (check) the budget with me tomorrow morning.
答案：to check

6. 完成句子：这个符号代表百分之五十。
This symbol ________ 50 ________.
答案：represents；per cent

Unit 2（核心知识）##二、核心短语.t:
1. 根据中文提示写出正确的英文短语：航班时刻表 ______  
答案：flight schedule

2. 用方框中的短语填空：go up / go down  
The price of the toy cars may ______ if fewer people buy them.  
答案：go down

3. 单项选择：Please ______ my phone number before you leave.  
A. write down  B. go up  C. instead of  D. for a moment  
答案：A

4. 句型转换：They went to the park by bike instead of taking a bus.（改为同义句，用 instead of 的反义表达）  
They went to the park by bike ______ ______ taking a bus.  
答案：rather than

5. 完成句子：她毫不犹豫地回答了问题。  
She answered the question ______ ______.  
答案：without hesitation

6. 词义辨析：选词填空：for a moment / at the moment  
Can you wait ______? I need to find my ticket.  
答案：for a moment

Unit 2（核心知识）##三、重点句型.t:
1. 根据句意和首字母提示填空：The old man came to the palace and the king c______ him to a game.
答案：challenged

2. 用所给词的适当形式填空：If you ______ (win) the game, you can have any prize.
答案：win

3. 单项选择：He looked at the small piece of gold in his hand and wondered ______ with it.
A. what to do
B. how to do
C. what to do it
D. how do
答案：A

4. 句型转换：The old man replied without hesitation.（改为同义句）
The old man replied ______ ______.
答案：without hesitating

5. 完成句子：想了一会儿之后，国王同意了。
After ______ ______ it for a moment, the king agreed.
答案：thinking about

6. 根据汉语提示完成句子：然后我们需要核对火车或航班时刻表。
And then we need to check the train or ______ ______.
答案：flight schedule

Unit 2（核心知识）##四、核心语法（基数词和序数词）.t:
1. 用英语写出“第12”这个序数词：______。
答案：twelfth

2. 选择填空：There are ______ students in our school, and ______ of them like playing basketball.
A. five hundred; hundreds
B. five hundreds; hundred
C. five hundred; hundred
D. five hundreds; hundreds
答案：A

3. 将下列句子中的时间改为用“past / to”表达：The film starts at 7:45.
答案：The film starts at a quarter to eight.

4. 完成句子：我们教室长8米，宽6米。
Our classroom is ______ ______ ______ and ______ ______ ______.
答案：eight meters long; six meters wide

5. 用英语表达“3/4”和“11%”：
3/4：______；11%：______。
答案：three quarters / three fourths; eleven per cent

6. 句型转换：He is a boy. He is eight years old.（合并为一句，用复合形容词改写）
答案：He is an eight-year-old boy.

Unit 2（核心知识）##全部.t:
用所给单词的正确形式填空：Look! There are five ______ (thousand) people waiting for the flight at the airport.
答案：thousand

根据句意选择正确的单词填空：He looked at the small piece of gold in his hand and ______ (wondered / replied) what to do with it.
答案：wondered

用英语写出“9 减 3 等于 6”：________________________________________
答案：9 minus 3 equals/is 6.

将下列句子翻译成英语：想了一会儿之后，国王同意了。
答案：After thinking about it for a moment, the king agreed.

单项选择：There are ______ students in our school, and ______ of them are from the countryside.
A. two thousands; hundreds    B. two thousand; hundreds
C. two thousand; hundred      D. two thousands; hundred
答案：B

用英语表示时间 8:30 和 11:45（各写两种表达方式）。
答案：8:30 — at half past eight / at eight thirty；11:45 — at a quarter to twelve / at eleven forty-five

Unit 2（知识梳理）##全部.t:
The old man replied ______ hesitation and asked for one grain of rice.
答案：without

用恰当的介词填空：Please write ______ the flight number before you leave.
答案：down

用 challenge 的适当形式填空：Our school ______ theirs to a basketball match yesterday.
答案：challenged

单项选择：I don’t like coffee. I’ll have tea ______.
A. instead of  B. instead  C. too  D. also
答案：B

用括号内所给词的适当形式填空：Two ______ (hundred) students are in the hall.
答案：hundred

根据句意填空：The population of the city went ______ sharply after 2000.
答案：up

Unit 3（核心知识）##一、核心词汇.t:
用所给单词的适当形式填空：The Internet has changed our lives in many ways, and its ______ (affect) on young people is huge.
答案：effect
选词填空（每词限用一次）：positive / negative / social / digital
My father often reads news on his ______ newspaper, while my mother prefers paper books.
答案：digital
根据句意和首字母提示补全单词：The heavy rain caused a serious f______ in the village, and many people lost their homes.
答案：flood
单项选择：
The teacher warned us ______ in the river because it was too dangerous.
A. not swim  B. not to swim  C. don't swim  D. to not swim
答案：B
句型转换：People use mobile phones to download apps every day.（改为被动语态）
Mobile phones ______ ______ to download apps every day.
答案：are used
完成句子（每空一词）：这家公司主要在网络上销售电脑软件。
This company mainly sells computer ______ ______ on the Internet.
答案：software；online（或 software；websites，若强调网络平台也可，但“on the Internet”已给出，此处更常填 online）

Unit 3（核心知识）##二、核心短语.t:
1. 单词拼写：The Internet can c________ us to people all over the world.
答案：connect

2. 词义辨析：选出与“in person”意思最接近的一项：A. by phone  B. face to face  C. by letter
答案：B

3. 固定搭配：Mobile payment has ________ big changes ________ our daily life.
A. brought; to  B. taken; for  C. warned; about
答案：A

4. 句型转换：We should share the good news with our friends.（改为同义句）
We should ________ the good news ________ our friends.
答案：share; with

5. 语法选择：The use of computers has a great effect ________ the way we study.
A. in  B. on  C. at
答案：B

6. 完成句子：我们应该与父母保持联系。
We should ________ ________ ________ ________ our parents.
答案：stay in touch with

Unit 3（核心知识）##三、重点句型.t:
1. 根据汉语提示写出单词：The internet has brought big ________ (变化) to everyday life.
答案：changes

2. 用括号中所给词的适当形式填空：In the future, even more things ________ (connect) to the internet.
答案：will be connected

3. 单项选择：Some computers are even ________ than human beings.
A. smart  B. smarter  C. smartest  D. the smartest
答案：B

4. 句型转换：Smart cities will be more eco-friendly than cities today. (改为一般疑问句)
答案：Will smart cities be more eco-friendly than cities today?

5. 完成句子：事故将更少，因为汽车将自动驾驶。
There will be ________ ________ because cars will drive themselves.
答案：fewer accidents

6. 根据汉语意思完成句子：你认为互联网对我们的日常生活有负面影响吗？
Do you think the internet has ________ ________ on our daily lives?
答案：negative effects

Unit 3（核心知识）##四、核心语法【形容词的比较级和最高级（一）】.t:
1. 用所给词的适当形式填空：Of all the students in our class, Li Ming is ________ (tall).
答案：the tallest

2. 单项选择：This book is ________ than that one. A. interesting B. more interesting C. most interesting
答案：B

3. 用所给词的适当形式填空：The weather is getting ________ and ________ (hot) in summer.
答案：hotter; hotter

4. 单项选择：Shanghai is one of the ________ cities in China. A. large B. larger C. largest
答案：C

5. 句型转换：Tom is taller than Jack.（改为同义句，用比较级 the 结构）Tom is ________ ________ of the two.
答案：the taller

6. 完成句子：你学习越努力，你取得的进步就越大。________ ________ you study, ________ ________ progress you will make.
答案：The harder; the greater

Unit 3（核心知识）##全部.t:
1. 用所给词的适当形式填空：The internet has brought big ______ (change) to everyday life.
答案：changes

2. 根据汉语意思完成句子：未来，会有更多事物接入互联网，因此生活将继续发生变化。

答案：connected to

答案：B

4. 用所给词的适当形式填空：Of all the cities, Shanghai is one of the ______ (large) cities in China.

5. 根据汉语意思完成句子：你学习越努力，你知道得就越多。
______ ______ you study, ______ ______ you know.

6. 单项选择：Do you think the internet has negative ______ on our daily lives?
A. effect  B. effects  C. affect  D. affects
答案：B

Unit 3（知识梳理）##全部.t:
1. 用方框中所给单词的适当形式填空：The heavy rain caused a serious ________ in the village, and many people lost their homes.

2. 根据汉语意思完成句子：这家公司给我们的日常生活带来了巨大的变化。

Unit 4（核心知识）##一、核心词汇.t:
1. 根据英文释义写出单词：a large round object filled with air, used as a toy or decoration.
答案：balloon

2. 用括号中所给单词的正确形式填空：I don't think the film is interesting. ______ (person), I prefer the one we saw last week.
答案：Personally

3. 选择正确答案：Although it was raining heavily, ______ they went to school on time.

答案：B

4. 将下列句子改为同义句，每空一词：You should stay away from junk food.

5. 从方框中选择合适的单词填空：depend, depend on, depended
—Will you go to the park tomorrow?
—It ______ the weather. If it rains, I won't go.

6. 根据汉语意思完成句子，每空一词：就我个人而言，我认为这个决定取决于你。

答案：Personally speaking, depends on

Unit 4（核心知识）##二、核心短语.t:

答案：steam

从方框中选择合适的短语填空：Don't ________ him just because he made a mistake. Everyone needs encouragement.
答案：make fun of

用所给短语的适当形式填空：A large number of tourists ________ (visit) the Great Wall every year.
答案：visit

单项选择：The accident ________ on a rainy night last week.
A. took place  B. takes place  C. will take place  D. is taking place
答案：A

按要求完成句子，每空一词：You can depend on him to finish the task.（改为同义句）
You can ________ ________ him to finish the task.
答案：rely on

将下列句子翻译成英语：毫无疑问，学好英语对我们很重要。
答案：Without doubt, learning English well is very important to us.

Unit 4（核心知识）##三、重点句型.t:
